Playing together

Listening for the first phrase.

Timed pieces leave space for the last notes, then fade to silence. Pause holds the piece’s clock.

Motion

Each traveller’s Expression controls set its own speed, note spacing, volume, and stereo position. Overall pace scales all speeds. Restart replays the journey seed.

Sound

Decay adjusts all three instruments; the readout shows the selected traveller’s duration.

Delay

Soft repeats of all three instruments. Echoes get darker and quieter as they fade.

Reading the image +

Increase for faint lines; decrease for shadows or paper texture. Click the image after rebuilding to choose your start.

HOW TO LISTEN

Choose a traveller’s Set start, then click a line or junction. Press Listen to send all enabled points wandering together. Each color has its own instrument.

Try felt piano, nylon harp, wooden kalimba, marimba, singing bowl, breathy flute, soft strings, or the original felt bell and resonances. These are synthesized interpretations with distinct tones and envelopes.

Choose a scale to snap pitches to notes, or Free · no scale for continuous pitches. Each traveller keeps its own octave. Room and delay connect the ensemble; recording includes both effects.
